# G3-pinned — live public-marketplace round trip on the PINNED route, at tag v0.4.0

Lane: **G3-pinned**. Read-only on the repository: no tracked file edited, nothing pushed. One issue filed
(#313), one comment posted (#312). The canonical checkout was read with `git show`/`ls-tree`/`rev-parse` and two
`git fetch origin <branch>` calls (`lane/bump-0.5.0`, `main`) that update remote-tracking refs only — no working
tree, branch or tracked file changed; `git status` clean before and after. Run 2026-09-04 ~17:07–17:15 UTC, Windows 11 Enterprise, PowerShell 7.6.5
driving `claude.exe` 2.1.260; every plugin script ran under Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.8875
(`powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File …`, the plugin's runtime), launched from the pwsh parent.

Masking per common-brief rule 15: the operator account segment is written `<operator>`, the clone's
private parent folders `<clone-root>`, the computer name `<hostname>`, the session scratchpad segment
`<scratchpad-session>`. One substitution class each; every other character of every capture is verbatim.
Every capture below is WHOLE (the driver wrote stdout+stderr to a file and the file is pasted, never tailed).

Scratch profile: `C:\kstmp\g3-pinned\profile`, created empty (0 entries), deleted at the end (Test-Path False).
**Rule 18 — no credential was placed and none was needed.** Every `claude plugin` subcommand exited 0 without
a login prompt. `~/.claude/.credentials.json` and `~/.claude.json` were never read, hashed, listed or copied.
No live `claude` session was started. `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` was set inside every tool call by the driver
(`captures/run.ps1`), which also cleared `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` / `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA` / `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR`
for every `bin/*.ps1` run (a command is never handed them) and re-hashed the operator's live settings.json after
every command.

## Stated limits (rule 18 — no live session)

1. **Live slash commands** (`/lw-watchtower:setup`, `:doctor`, `:config`, `:delegate`, `:uninstall`, `:update`) were not run in a session. Each was exercised through its `bin/*.ps1` script with the exit its `commands/*.md` documents.
2. **Doctor exit 0 was reached only after a hand-run of the SessionStart hook.** With no session, nothing creates `<profile>\plugins\data\lw-watchtower-leapware-watchtower` or writes `lw-watchtower.jsonl`, and the doctor exits 1 on `state-dir` + `sessionstart` (capture 07a) — which is what install.md says. Capture 07b runs `lib/session_start.ps1` and `lib/supervisor.ps1 -HookEvent SessionStart` by hand with `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=<cache>` and `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=<profile>\plugins\data\lw-watchtower-leapware-watchtower` (the name install.md:567 says the CLI uses) and a fixture payload. That the CLI hands a real hook exactly those values, and that the hook fires at all in a real session, is NOT established here.
3. **The SessionStart banner** was seen only as the hook's JSON (`systemMessage`: `LW-WATCHTOWER v0.4.0 · 7/11 modules enabled (4 off) · 0 gates · observe-only`), not rendered in a session.
4. `claude-version` doctor row: `CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION` is not exported by the CLI, so the events `SubagentStart`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `StopFailure` were not verified against this build (the row says so and passes as a limit).
5. Whether the plain route (`…/LEAPWare-Watchtower` with no ref) still lands on `7952992` is G3-plain's assertion, not this lane's; this lane proves the pinned route, which survives the #294 merge.

- **Filed #313** (docs, sev:low, milestone v0.4.0; tag is cut → release notes + v0.5.0): `commands/setup.md:36` is headed *"Ask the six questions"*; `-Step detect` prints four and says two are gone. Ships in the 35-file payload.
- **Commented on #312** (already filed by G3-plain at 17:11:48Z, sev:medium — the stale "no release tag yet" sentences on README/install/faq/SECURITY): added the pinned-route measurement and a sentence for the document pass, since `docs/install.md:123` ("no honest way to pin this route … this page does not claim one") can now honestly carry `…@v0.4.0`. Not a duplicate issue.
- Not a finding, recorded: the 16 `.ps1` in the cache differ from their git blobs by line endings only (the repository's own `eol=crlf` attribute), and byte-equal the marketplace clone's checkout.
- Not a finding, recorded: `bin/lwg-uninstall.ps1 -RemoveData` leaves the empty CLI data root `plugins\data` (see step 11).
- Not a finding, recorded: `claude plugin validate <cache>` → `✔ Validation passed`, EXIT 0.

statusLine is a settings.json key. A plugin cannot supply one - there is no
manifest field for it and no hook event renders a line - which is half the reason
this installer exists. It renders the HH health segment, and it is this plugin's
only CONTINUOUS indicator - not its only visible one. Unwired, you still get the
banner at session start and an advisory at the end of a turn; what you lose is
everything in between, which is where a fault first shows.

--- WHAT WOULD CHANGE -----------------------------------------------------
MODE: copy
  A copy of the tracked file goes into your home folder, and the setting points at
  the copy.
  TRADE-OFF: the indicator keeps working if this project folder is moved, renamed,
  or is part-way through a git operation. But the copy and the original are then
  two independent files and NOTHING on this machine compares them automatically -
  edit either and the other is silently stale, including the case that costs most,
  a fix made to the live copy and overwritten the next time this is run.
  /lw-watchtower:doctor is what detects that drift, afterwards.

  ACTION 1  create
            file  C:\kstmp\g3-pinned\profile\statusline.ps1
            from  C:\kstmp\g3-pinned\profile\plugins\cache\leapware-watchtower\lw-watchtower\0.4.0\statusline\statusline.ps1

  ACTION 2  set the statusLine key in the settings file

  AFTER:

        "type":  "command",
        "command":  "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \"C:/kstmp/g3-pinned/profile/statusline.ps1\"",
        "refreshInterval":  120
    }

--- WHAT WOULD NOT CHANGE -------------------------------------------------
  2 other top-level key(s) compared value-by-value: all unchanged
  No other section is touched. statusLine and hooks are written
  one at a time, each behind its own yes.

whole file. Indentation becomes PowerShell's four spaces, and the characters
< > & ' are written as \u003c \u003e \u0026 \u0027. Every VALUE is unchanged and
the file is backed up first, but the byte layout of untouched sections does move.

delegate is OFF    (reserve the chat session for operator communication - all work goes to subagents)

  changed        : nothing was written - no value was given, so this is a report only
  global default : off
  repo override  : none - falls through to the global default   [not in a recognised repo; per-repo overrides cannot apply]
  effective here : OFF
  stored in      : C:\kstmp\g3-pinned\profile\plugins\data\lw-watchtower-leapware-watchtower\config.override.json -> interaction.delegate
  merged over    : C:\kstmp\g3-pinned\profile\plugins\cache\leapware-watchtower\lw-watchtower\0.4.0\config.json   [the shipped defaults; this command never writes it]
  config source  : config.json
  override       : none yet - every value above is the shipped default

IN EFFECT FROM NOW ON, in this session:

  Work may be done directly on the main thread.

ENFORCED - what this switch actually blocks, and what that costs

  delegate IS enforced, and it is the only thing in this plugin that is. Turning it on
  arms delegate_gate - lib/gate_delegate.ps1, a PreToolUse hook on
  Edit|Write|NotebookEdit|Bash|PowerShell - which REFUSES those five tools for any call that did
  not come from a subagent. The refusal is a real block: PreToolUse deny is honoured
  even under permissions.defaultMode "bypassPermissions". A subagent is identified by
  the presence of agent_id in the hook payload, never by agent_type, because a
  settings.json `agent` key gives the MAIN thread a non-empty agent_type.
  
  WHAT TURNING IT ON COSTS, and it is not reversible from here: with the gate armed,
  /lw-watchtower:delegate off will NOT work from the main thread. This command runs through
  Bash, and Bash is one of the five tools refused - so is PowerShell, so switching shell
  is not a way round it either. There is deliberately no exemption
  for it - an exemption for "the command that turns me off" is a named bypass. The two
  ways back are to have a SUBAGENT run /lw-watchtower:delegate off, or to set
  interaction.delegate to false by hand in the override file named under `stored in`
  above - config.json in the plugin root is the shipped defaults and setting it there
  would be overridden by the file that says true.
  
  What it still does NOT do: it does not check that a dispatch was any good, and it
  refuses nothing a subagent does. Delegation is enforced; delegating well is not.

  A governance module. delegate is the switch on delegate_gate in the module
  registry in lib/common.ps1 - kind "gate", the only one - so the banner counts it
  and the live-gate count moves with it. Its FLAG stays out of the "modules" block
  on purpose: one gate must have one switch, and Get-LwgConfig fails OPEN, which
  would arm a blocking hook off an unreadable config. The SessionStart banner
  reports gates shipped and gates live as separate numbers; start a new session,
  or read interaction.delegate in C:\kstmp\g3-pinned\profile\plugins\data\lw-watchtower-leapware-watchtower\config.override.json, to see this land.

## the driver (captures/run.ps1), verbatim

```powershell
# g3-pinned driver: runs one command with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR set, captures stdout+stderr whole, records the exit code,
# and re-hashes the operator's live settings.json after the command. Usage: run.ps1 -Name <capture-name> -Cmd { scriptblock }
param([string]$Name, [scriptblock]$Cmd, [string]$Cwd = 'C:\kstmp\g3-pinned')
$S = 'C:\kstmp\claude\<scratchpad-session>\ffd9b206-bef9-4260-a2d6-ff11280690b8\scratchpad\g3-pinned\captures'
$env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR = 'C:\kstmp\g3-pinned\profile'
$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT = ''
$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA = ''
$env:CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR = ''
Push-Location $Cwd
$out = & $Cmd 2>&1 | Out-String
$code = $LASTEXITCODE
Pop-Location
$live = (Get-FileHash "$env:USERPROFILE\.claude\settings.json" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
$text = "CAPTURE: $Name`nCWD: $Cwd`nCLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`n---- OUTPUT ----`n$out---- END ----`nEXIT=$code`nLIVE-SETTINGS-SHA256=$live`n"
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$S\$Name.txt", $text, [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
Write-Output $text

```
